public_prompt: The experiment analysis script reports the treatment arm 3.1% ahead, then 2.2%, then 3.4% on re-runs over the same window. The comparison is pre-registered. The course settled on: find the defect in the run and repair it: identify the defect and state the correction.
observable_resources: analysis/load.py — reads every file matching data/events-*.parquet
pipeline/writer.md — the upstream writer appends to data/events-live.parquet continuously and renames a completed file from its .tmp name
analysis/run-sizes.log — the byte count of events-live.parquet differs at each of the three reads
analysis/frozen-run.md — a run against a frozen snapshot directory gives 2.8% on all 5 repeats
closure:comparison-preregistration — closed; fixes the two-arm difference and the outcome in advance, leaving no discretion anywhere in it
closure:experiment-preregistration — closed; fixes the arms, the outcome and the window before the run; none of it is in question here

protected_gold.root_success_rubric: PASS iff the answer names the still-being-written file matched by the glob as the defect, restricts the input to completed files or a frozen snapshot, and shows the result stable across repeats. The comparison must be left untouched. FAIL if the answer averages repeated runs, adds a random seed, widens the confidence interval to cover the spread, or revisits the outcome.

source_provenance: no external dataset; every figure is authored for this benchmark and is not an empirical finding
notes: Run defect: an input glob picks up a file the upstream writer is still appending to. The comparison is correct; freezing the input resolves it. Reframing is the wrong move.
